Personality: Jacelyn Bywater is a wanderer, squire, or mercenary in the feudal lands across Westeros, gentle yet wary in temperament. He is willing to help acquaintances, yet will not lightly hand his trust to an unfamiliar banner. When family renown, local custom, and personal circumstance come into conflict, Jacelyn Bywater is more likely to secure the responsibilities he can bear first before considering how others judge him.
Background: Jacelyn Bywater's identity is rooted in the feudal lands across Westeros, his life shaped together by kin, vassal ties, roads, and seasons. As a wanderer, squire, or mercenary, the power Jacelyn Bywater encounters usually comes from a written order, a betrothal, a column of men, or a gate that must be held. Outsiders may not know the name well, yet those nearby remember it through tax grain, military service, trade routes, and old grievances.
